name: GXO Logistics Distribution Center - Houston TX (West Greens)

fieldNotes.site: GXO Logistics warehouse at 4800 W Greens Rd, NW Houston. Pin (ROOFTOP geocode) lands on a very large bulk-distribution warehouse oriented NW-SE; address confirmed via warehouse directories (Evopra, Racklify, AWCO). Building set back from W Greens Rd behind a fenced lawn.
fieldNotes.truckGate: FALSE — the property has a perimeter fence (black ornamental metal along the W Greens Rd frontage, chain-link along side property lines), but no guard booth and no barrier arm/sliding gate across any truck lane was found. The truck courts on the NE and SW building faces are entered via open driveways. The frontage fence is a property-line/decorative fence around the office and lawn, not a controlled truck checkpoint.
fieldNotes.guardShack: FALSE — no booth structure observed at any entrance in satellite or Street View.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ — very large warehouse with continuous dock-door banks on the NE long face (main truck court) and the SW face; ~90 doors estimated, low confidence on exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 0-10 — the NE truck court holds mostly staged industrial materials (pipe/conduit bundles) rather than parked trailers; only a handful of trailers seen. No dedicated trailer-storage lot.
fieldNotes.dropYard: FALSE — no dedicated trailer-storage yard; the NE yard is a working dock apron with material staging.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on opposite (NE and SW) building faces support physically separate shipping/receiving.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide internal truck court on the NE side provides ample paved holding space inside the property.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open driveways and generous paved aprons leave physical room to add a bypass lane if a gate were installed.
fieldNotes.confidence: Medium — building positively located but no Street View coverage of the interior truck courts; dock-door and trailer counts are honest overhead estimates. The gate/guard-shack call (none) is confident from satellite.
